paragraphs.dominant_move: incident-and-purpose: A robust model can support a waterborne lost-plane search. -> introduces the response objective -> moves to initial location inputs
location-bound: Last contact and heading can yield a constrained crash area. -> produces an initial search area -> current movement changes that area
dynamic-update: Currents move and reshape the region, while debris permits reverse tracing. -> supports repeated location refinement -> search algorithms act on the updated region

comparison-and-decision: Scenario analysis makes an algorithm and time estimate conditional on operating factors. -> offers a conditional route selection -> the body explains the underlying components
task-routing: Effective response requires linked location, adaptable route, and current-based recovery tasks. -> establishes the model's three-stage logic -> assumptions define the usable regime

global_organization_chain: scenario comparison and conditional method choice
future repair, conclusion, and stakeholder iteration
Only after the complete positive chain does G7 record notation, probability, calibration, geometry, scheduling, provenance, and visual warnings.

moves: input: A lost-aircraft incident, last known flight state, ocean setting, available search resources, and uncertain recovery time.
rhetorical job: Compress the practical need into a complete route that makes the later paper legible before technical detail appears.
analytical job: Name the initial bound, day-by-day current displacement, reverse debris tracing, three search algorithms, and scenario comparison without deriving them yet.
output: A bounded promise: conditional estimates of where to search, which route to use, and how long debris recovery may take.
handoff: The contents and introduction unpack the route into assumptions, components, and calculations.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The summary's promised location-to-search route.
rhetorical job: Expose the architecture before the body begins, including sensitivity, limitations, conclusion, and a separate public communication artifact.
analytical job: Order assumptions, parameters, geometry, algorithms, results, error analysis, and operational reflection as dependencies rather than a topic pile.
output: A navigable source-heading map covering every printed technical and stakeholder section.
handoff: Introduction supplies the decision problem that gives this route its purpose.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: A plane likely lost over water and a desire to minimize the elapsed search time.
rhetorical job: Frame urgency while specifying the linked tasks a reader must accept as one response system.
analytical job: Separate initial-location estimation, adaptable search, and current-informed reconstruction into a three-part technical route.
output: A stated purpose and a preview of the model interfaces needed to fulfill it.
handoff: Assumptions constrain what each later interface may claim.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The three-task route and numerous unknown physical, sensing, personnel, and time conditions.
rhetorical job: Make simplifying commitments inspectable by attaching reasons rather than silently hiding them in equations.
analytical job: Fix worst-case crash behavior, omitted drag, visual-only debris search, flat water, daylight, fatigue, debris persistence, and airport distance assumptions.
output: A bounded problem regime in which the geometric and search calculations have defined meaning.
handoff: Parameters operationalize the assumptions as inputs to aircraft, drift, and search calculations.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: The accepted assumptions and the need to implement aircraft and search behavior.
rhetorical job: Bind operational facts to the later decision roles they play instead of presenting a detached symbol list.
analytical job: Connect altitude, velocity, mass, crash wind, aircraft range/count, available daylight, weather, visibility, current direction, and time since crash to later model outputs.
output: A parameter interface for location bounds, drift, sweep width, and route capacity.
handoff: Problem analysis uses the interface to split the response into location and search mechanisms.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Use the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain a last pass.

moves: input: Aircraft/search parameters and the stated need to find a plane quickly.
rhetorical job: Show why the proposed route is a deliberate decomposition, not a collection of convenient formulas.
analytical job: Divide the task into splash-down prediction and area search; reject spiral-like paths under an efficiency criterion; retain adaptable parallel-route candidates.
output: A justified six-component model architecture and a path-family screening rule.
handoff: Statement of Model turns the decomposition into linked components.

moves: input: Problem decomposition, aircraft/current/search parameters, and the admissible assumptions.
rhetorical job: Make a multi-stage system readable by enumerating its interfaces before deriving the individual calculations.
analytical job: Parameterize a downed plane, search plane, and debris drift; generate a crash region; determine how a path searches it; reverse-trace debris evidence.
output: An ordered interface chain from last contact to a changing search area and evidence feedback.
handoff: Grid and geometric construction make those interfaces computationally actionable.

moves: input: Aircraft state, glide and turn limits, wind uncertainty, and a local ocean-current field.
rhetorical job: Turn heterogeneous physical uncertainty into a represented computational object that later search algorithms can consume.

analytical job: Construct reachable edge points, expand the perimeter by wind, form a convex hull, place it over a grid, drift markers using discrete Euler updates, and rebuild the containing polygon.
output: A time-indexed, bounded n-gon/search grid with an explicit approximation rule.
handoff: Detection theory interprets coverage of this changing area as a probability objective.

moves: input: A bounded search area, aircraft capability inputs, time window, and a need to compare coverage fairly.
rhetorical job: Establish a baseline route and metric so later alternatives have a common decision standard.
analytical job: Define POD from time, aircraft count, rate, sweep width, and area; describe searchleg/crossleg structure; allocate legs by range; compute swept area.
output: A parallel-search baseline that returns day-level area coverage and a detection-relevant metric.
handoff: Alternative geometries modify the baseline's path and resource-use constraints.

moves: input: The parallel baseline, the shared POD/coverage objective, and limits on one-pass coverage.
rhetorical job: Make alternative designs comparable by explaining both the intended gain and the structural cost of each modification.
analytical job: Derive diagonal-area cases; allow surplus aircraft to re-sweep search blocks; account for delayed starts and decreasing legs within a block.
output: Two variants with explicit coverage logic, capacity use, and conditions that can later be tested against the baseline.

moves: input: Swept-area outputs from each route, a changing search polygon, and found-debris positions.

moves: input: The simulation route, sensitivity results, and documented assumptions.

main_argument_chains.claim: The initial search region is a conservative reachable set constrained by aircraft state, glide-turn geometry, and crash wind rather than a point-centered circle.
support_steps: initial area for a search route
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: search begins from a conservative geometric bound rather than a circular point estimate

main_argument_chains.claim: Daily route choice follows from the drifting region, sensing conditions, aircraft resources, route geometry, and a scenario-conditioned detection-time comparison.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: route choice depends on area, weather, visibility, and aircraft availability

main_argument_chains.claim: Found debris should be propagated backward through the current field to revise the crash estimate and the next forward search cycle.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: each finding should update the next operational search rather than only confirm a fixed initial map

warnings.warning: Equation 1 inserts 1.5t directly into cosine after defining the turn rate as 1.5 degrees per second. A numerical implementation must state whether the trigonometric function receives degrees or radians and apply the conversion explicitly.

Equation 7 visibly spaces the total-leg symbol as T L_i and compresses the summand around L_i, 1, 2, and 3. Preserve the printed ambiguity and reconstruct the intended finite sequence with typed indices before coding it.

Equation 9 prints the region name with a visibly spaced n-gon token while defining A_search as maximum width times maximum height. That quantity is the axis-aligned bounding rectangle, not the area of the drifting polygon, and the distinction must survive transcription.

The daily stopping rule is displayed as a sum of POD values exceeding 0.95. Daily PODs are not automatically additive probabilities; a reusable implementation needs an explicit conditional miss or survival update, dependence assumptions for repeated passes, and the day-specific moving area.

Effective sweep width is interpolated from an unfrozen external table and later altered by an unstated piecewise wind function. Target size, observer performance, sensor mode, units, interpolation domain, and calibration evidence are missing, so the resulting POD is not a field-calibrated detection probability.

The current update lacks a frozen current grid, coordinate reference system, longitude/latitude unit contract, spatial interpolation rule, boundary behavior, and time-step convergence check. The source also limits available current data to the MH370 vicinity, so neither forward nor reverse drift transfers globally.

Plane assignment is sequential and greedy: each plane takes the block of its type with most empty space, delayed aircraft lose one leg, and extra aircraft repeat earlier coverage. No joint scheduling optimality, conflict separation, overlap correlation, or independent repeated-pass detection model is established.

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: Place three candidate rectangular-area search patterns side by side so the method discussion can reject the inward spiral and retain parallel and diagonal sweeps for quantitative development.
Make the current-field mechanism visually concrete before the paper uses forward drift to move a crash/search area and reverse drift to infer an origin from found debris.
Translate the turn-radius and remaining-glide calculation into an inspectable geometric mechanism before the parametric endpoint equations are introduced.
Show how the parametric turn-and-glide equations map sampled left-turn angles into a noncircular endpoint locus and distinguish that locus from the turn-radius circle.
Mirror the left-turn locus to include right turns and expose the nonconvex full endpoint boundary that is subsequently wind-expanded and simplified by a convex hull.
Define searchleg, crossleg, track-space, searchleg-length, and turn-diameter geometry so the parallel swept-area algorithm can separate searching distance from repositioning distance.
Compare modeled completion days for diagonal and optimized-parallel searches over the paper's indexed scenario set and connect scenario outcomes to conditional algorithm recommendations.
